subject: Renewal: Novus scale-up — credit phasing & invoice timing request
messages:
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@novus.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novus.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal ask — phasing credits and invoice timing

Hi Avery,

We're getting ready to sign the renewal for Novus (12 months) but we need a cleaner path on two items before legal issues the PO: 1) a phased credit schedule to smooth our near-term bill given an expected ramp, and 2) invoice timing aligned to our internal fiscal cadence (we prefer monthly consolidated invoices starting June 1).

Our usage is projected to increase ~2.5x over the next 90 days as we roll out a second pilot. Given that, can you:
- Propose a credit/phasing plan that front-loads some cushion for Q2 while protecting Redwood's unit economics;
- Confirm you can hold pricing for at least 90 days from the renewal effective date (price-hold window);
- Provide a consolidated invoice schedule and the billing contact to loop Procurement into (they're cc'd).

I've attached the PO (Novus_PO_20270517.pdf) for reference. Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Morris
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novus AI
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@novus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — phasing credits and invoice timing

Hi Dana — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. We're excited to scale with you.

High-level proposal (we'll formalize in the SOW / commercial addendum):
- Term: 12 months, effective June 1, 2027.
- Capacity/commit: increase from current 1.0M tokens/month to 2.5M tokens/month (staged ramp over 60 days).
- Price hold: we can hold the agreed unit price for 90 days after go-live (June 1–Aug 30).
- Phased credits: to smooth Q2 impact we propose a 3-tier credit: 40% credit on overage invoices in June, 25% in July, 10% in August (applied to token overages above committed volume only). Credits will be applied as line-item adjustments on the subsequent consolidated invoice.
- Discount: in exchange for the committed uplift and a signed 12-month term, we can offer a one-time "acceleration credit" equal to 10% of the first quarter's invoice (capped at $50k).
- Invoicing: monthly consolidated invoices, billed to Procurement (procurement@novus.ai). Payments Net 30.

I've attached Draft_SOW_v2.docx with the staged ramp and acceptance criteria. Before I send this to legal, can I get quick internal approvals on the credit caps and the one-time acceleration credit? Marissa / Ben / Laura — quick read and thumbs?

If this looks reasonable to you, Dana, we'll push the commercial addendum and get a DocuSign link over today.

Cheers,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Novus renewal concession ask — numbers and approval needed

Folks —
Recap of external ask (see thread below) and proposed concessions:
- One-time acceleration credit: 10% of Q3 start invoices (est. cap $50k) in exchange for +1.5x commit and 12-month term.
- Phased overage credits: 40%/25%/10% on overages for Jun/Jul/Aug to avoid sticker shock during ramp.
- Price-hold for 90 days.

Revenue impact (ballpark):
- ARR baseline (if commit held at new level) ~ $480k ARR.
- Upfront credit liability: worst-case credit recognition spread across 90 days ~ $35k–$50k (depending on actual usage).
- We recover via committed volume and expected long-term expansion; ops lift minimal.

Risks: small near-term margin erosion vs. retention/upsell upside. Legal will want precise language around credit application and expiration. Billing ops: will need consolidated invoice mapping and GL codes; Laura, can your team accept the proposed invoice adjustments?

Ask: approve the one-time acceleration credit cap at $50k and the phased overage credit structure so I can send DocuSign and the commercial addendum to Novus today. If you want tighter caps, suggest alternate numbers (e.g., $30k cap / 30%/15%/5%). Need a yes/no by 3pm PT so we don't lose momentum.

Thanks — Avery

(on Behalf: Novus renewal / ND-2027-045)
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@novus.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novus.ai>

Avery — this looks actionable and appreciative of the flexibility. Procurement confirms monthly consolidated invoices and Net 30. A couple of asks from our side before DocuSign:
- Please include the credit application language in the commercial addendum (where credits will appear as line items against the following invoice).
- Can you confirm the GL code field we should expect on the invoice (we need it to match our PO)?
- Legal will push a short liability clause around the credits (standard).

If you can send the commercial addendum + DocuSign with those items called out, we'll aim to sign by EOD tomorrow. Thanks for moving quickly — the ramp is time-sensitive.

Regards,
Dana
